<style>
:root{
  --blue:       #2563eb;
  --blue-dark:  #1e3a8a;
  --blue-mid:   #1d4ed8;
  --blue-lt:    #bfdbfe;
  --blue-xlx:   #eff6ff;
  --blue-muted: #60a5fa;
  --surface:    #ffffff;
  --border:     #dbeafe;
  --text:       #0f172a;
  --text-2:     #374151;
  --muted:      #6b7280;
  --red:        #ef4444;
  --red-dark:   #dc2626;
  --green:      #4ade80;
  --radius:     14px;
  --radius-sm:  9px;
  --shadow:     0 1px 4px rgba(37,99,235,.07),0 4px 16px rgba(37,99,235,.08);
  --shadow-md:  0 4px 20px rgba(37,99,235,.14);
  --font:       'Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
}

*,::before,::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{font-size:16px;scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{font-family:var(--font);background:var(--blue-xlx);color:var(--text);line-height:1.6;min-height:100svh;direction:ltr;text-align:left}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.skip-nav{position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:auto;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden}
.skip-nav:focus{position:fixed;left:16px;top:16px;width:auto;height:auto;padding:10px 18px;background:var(--blue-dark);color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;border-radius:8px;z-index:9999;overflow:visible}

/* ── NAV ── */
.nav{
  background:var(--blue);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--blue-mid);
  height:58px;padding:0 22px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:200;
  box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(37,99,235,.4);
}
.nav-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:#fff;font-weight:900;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.5px;line-height:1}
.nav-ball{font-size:22px;line-height:1}
.nav-name em{font-style:normal;color:var(--blue-lt)}
.live-pill{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);
  color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;
  padding:5px 13px;border-radius:20px;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.4px;text-transform:uppercase;
}
.live-pill-dot{
  width:7px;height:7px;background:var(--green);border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;
  animation:blink 1.3s ease-in-out infinite;box-shadow:0 0 5px var(--green);
}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.2}}

/* ── HERO ── */
.hero{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue-dark) 0%,var(--blue) 60%,#3b82f6 100%);
  color:#fff;padding:30px 20px 32px;text-align:center;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.hero::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 55% at 50% 0%,rgba(191,219,254,.15),transparent 70%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.hero::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-1px;left:0;right:0;height:30px;
  background:var(--blue-xlx);clip-path:ellipse(55% 100% at 50% 100%);
}
.hero-badge{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);
  color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;
  padding:4px 14px;border-radius:20px;margin-bottom:14px;letter-spacing:.3px;
}
.hero-badge-dot{width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--green);border-radius:50%;animation:blink 1.3s infinite;box-shadow:0 0 4px var(--green)}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(22px,5vw,38px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.15;margin-bottom:10px;letter-spacing:-.4px}
.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--blue-lt)}
.hero-sub{font-size:clamp(13px,2.5vw,15px);color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);max-width:600px;margin:0 auto 18px;line-height:1.8}
.hero-sub strong{color:#fff}
.chip-row{display:flex;gap:7px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chip{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;
  padding:5px 14px;border-radius:20px;letter-spacing:.1px;transition:background .2s;
}
.chip:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.chip-hot{background:rgba(239,68,68,.3);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.5);color:#fff}

/* ── WRAP ── */
.wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px 14px 40px}

/* ── DATE BAR ── */
.date-bar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:11px 18px;
  margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.date-bar-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue-dark)}
.date-bar-right{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.live-dot{width:8px;height:8px;background:var(--red);border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;animation:blink 1.3s infinite;box-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(239,68,68,.5)}

/* ── MATCHES BOX ── */
.matches-box{
  background:var(--surface);border-radius:16px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(37,99,235,.06),0 4px 20px rgba(37,99,235,.08);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.matches-list{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}

/* ── ROW ── */
.match-row{border-bottom:1px solid var(--blue-xlx);position:relative}
.match-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.match-inner{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:22px 1fr auto;
  align-items:center;gap:0 12px;padding:11px 16px;
  cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;color:var(--text);position:relative;
}
.match-inner::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:0;
  background:var(--blue);border-radius:0 2px 2px 0;transition:width .15s;
}
.match-inner:hover{background:var(--blue-xlx)}
.match-inner:hover::before{width:3px}
.match-row.finished .match-inner{opacity:.4;cursor:default}
.match-row.finished .match-inner:hover{background:transparent}
.match-row.finished .match-inner:hover::before{width:0}

.m-icon{font-size:15px;line-height:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;z-index:1}
.m-center{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.m-league{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue-muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.m-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;line-height:1.3}
.m-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;z-index:1}

.m-pill{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:20px;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.1px}
.m-pill-upcoming{background:var(--blue-xlx);color:var(--blue);border:1px solid var(--border)}
.m-pill-live{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ef4444,#dc2626);color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(239,68,68,.35);animation:pulse 1.6s infinite;border:none;
}
.m-pill-ft{background:#f0fdf4;color:#059669;border:1px solid #bbf7d0}
.m-pill-score{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue-dark),var(--blue));
  color:#fff;border:none;letter-spacing:.5px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.85;transform:scale(.97)}}
.m-arrow{color:var(--border);font-size:18px;font-style:normal;line-height:1;font-weight:300;transition:color .15s,transform .15s}
.match-inner:hover .m-arrow{color:var(--blue);transform:translateX(2px)}

@media(max-width:520px){
  .match-inner{grid-template-columns:18px 1fr auto;padding:10px 14px;gap:0 10px}
  .m-name{font-size:13.5px}
  .m-pill{font-size:10px;padding:3px 8px}
  .m-arrow{font-size:16px}
}

/* ── STATES ── */
.state{text-align:center;padding:40px 16px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--muted)}
.spinner{
  width:36px;height:36px;
  border:2.5px solid var(--blue-lt);border-top-color:var(--blue);
  border-radius:50%;animation:spin .7s linear infinite;
  margin:0 auto 14px;
}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.state h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:5px}
.state p{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.75}
#error-state{display:none}
.retry-btn{
  margin-top:14px;padding:10px 26px;
  background:var(--blue);color:#fff;
  border:none;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);
  font-size:14px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font);
  transition:background .2s;
}
.retry-btn:hover{background:var(--blue-dark)}

/* ── OTHER SPORTS ── */
.section-bar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue-dark);
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;
  margin:24px 0 12px;
}
.section-bar-line{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--border)}

/* ── SEO SECTIONS ── */
.section{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--radius);padding:22px 20px;margin-top:20px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.section-title{
  font-size:17px;font-weight:900;color:var(--blue-dark);
  margin-bottom:14px;padding-bottom:10px;
  border-bottom:2px solid var(--blue-lt);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
}
.section-title em{font-style:normal;color:var(--blue)}
.section h3{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text-2);margin:14px 0 5px}
.section p{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.95;margin-bottom:8px}
.section p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.section strong{color:var(--blue-dark)}
.section a{color:var(--blue);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}

/* ── FEATURES ── */
.feat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(170px,1fr));gap:10px;margin:14px 0}
.feat-item{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  background:var(--blue-xlx);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:11px 13px;
  font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-2);
}
.feat-icon{font-size:18px;flex-shrink:0}

/* ── FAQ ── */
.faq-item{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:14px 0}
.faq-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;padding-bottom:0}
.faq-q{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:5px}
.faq-a{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.9}

/* ── FOOTER ── */
footer{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue-dark),var(--blue));
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);text-align:center;
  padding:28px 16px;font-size:12px;margin-top:24px;
}
footer strong{font-size:15px;color:#fff;display:block;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:900}
.foot-sub{font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);margin-bottom:10px}
.foot-tags{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0}
.foot-tag{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;
  padding:3px 11px;border-radius:20px;
}

/* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
@media(max-width:640px){
  .nav-brand{font-size:18px}
  .feat-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .section{padding:16px 14px}
  .hero{padding:24px 16px 26px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>

var OTHER_API = 'https://ws.kora-api.space/api/matches';
var STREAM    = 'https://xyzhesgoal-dev.smartagro.mov/';

function pad(n){return String(n).padStart(2,'0')}
function today(){var d=new Date();return d.getFullYear()+'-'+pad(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad(d.getDate())}
function ts(){var d=new Date();return d.getFullYear()+pad(d.getMonth()+1)+pad(d.getDate())+pad(d.getHours())+pad(d.getMinutes())}
function show(id,d){document.getElementById(id).style.display=d||'block'}
function hide(id){document.getElementById(id).style.display='none'}

function relTime(date,time){
  if(!date||!time) return null;
  var parts=time.split(':');
  if(parts.length<2) return null;
  var kick=new Date(date+'T'+pad(+parts[0])+':'+pad(+parts[1])+':00Z');
  if(isNaN(kick)) return null;
  var diff=Math.round((kick-Date.now())/60000);
  if(diff<=0) return null;
  var h=Math.floor(diff/60),m=diff%60;
  if(h===0) return 'in '+m+'m';
  if(m===0) return 'in '+h+'h';
  return 'in '+h+'h '+m+'m';
}

function sportIcon(cat,name){
  var l=(name||'').toLowerCase(),c=(cat||'').toLowerCase();
  if(l.includes('nba')||c.includes('basketball')) return '🏀';
  if(l.includes('nfl')||c.includes('american football')) return '🏈';
  if(l.includes('mlb')||c.includes('baseball')) return '⚾';
  if(l.includes('nhl')||c.includes('hockey')) return '🏒';
  if(l.includes('tennis')||c.includes('tennis')) return '🎾';
  if(l.includes('ufc')||l.includes('mma')||c.includes('mma')) return '🥋';
  if(l.includes('boxing')||c.includes('boxing')) return '🥊';
  if(l.includes('rugby')||c.includes('rugby')) return '🏉';
  if(l.includes('cricket')||c.includes('cricket')) return '🏏';
  if(l.includes('formula')||c.includes('formula')||c.includes('f1')) return '🏎️';
  if(l.includes('golf')||c.includes('golf')) return '⛳';
  return '🏅';
}

function leagueIcon(name){
  var l=(name||'').toLowerCase();
  if(l.includes('world cup'))         return '🏆';
  if(l.includes('champions league'))  return '⭐';
  if(l.includes('europa league'))     return '🔶';
  if(l.includes('conference league')) return '🔷';
  if(l.includes('premier league'))    return '🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿';
  if(l.includes('la liga'))           return '🇪🇸';
  if(l.includes('bundesliga'))        return '🇩🇪';
  if(l.includes('serie a'))           return '🇮🇹';
  if(l.includes('ligue 1'))           return '🇫🇷';
  if(l.includes('eredivisie'))        return '🇳🇱';
  if(l.includes('mls'))               return '🇺🇸';
  if(l.includes('euro'))              return '🇪🇺';
  if(l.includes('copa america'))      return '🌎';
  if(l.includes('afcon')||l.includes('africa cup')) return '🌍';
  if(l.includes('fa cup'))            return '🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿';
  return '⚽';
}

function soccerCard(m){
  var isLive=m.status===1, isDone=m.status===2;
  var hasStream=m.active==1&&m.has_channels==1;
  var url=hasStream?STREAM+'?m='+m.id+'&lang=en':'#';
  var search=(m.league_en+' '+m.home_en+' '+m.away_en).toLowerCase();
  var ic=leagueIcon(m.league_en);
  var rowCls='match-row'+(isDone?' finished':'');
  var pill;
  if(isLive){
    pill='<span class="m-pill m-pill-live">● LIVE</span>';
  } else if(isDone){
    var sc=m.score&&m.score!=='-'?m.score:'';
    pill='<span class="m-pill '+(sc?'m-pill-score':'m-pill-ft')+'">'+(sc||'Ended')+'</span>';
  } else {
    var rel=relTime(m.date,m.time);
    pill='<span class="m-pill m-pill-upcoming">'+(rel||m.time||'Soon')+'</span>';
  }
  var inner=
    '<span class="m-icon" aria-hidden="true">'+ic+'</span>'+
    '<span class="m-center">'+
      '<span class="m-league">'+(m.league_en||'')+'</span>'+
      '<span class="m-name">'+m.home_en+' vs '+m.away_en+'</span>'+
    '</span>'+
    '<span class="m-right">'+pill+'<i class="m-arrow" aria-hidden="true">›</i></span>';
  if(hasStream){
    return '<li class="'+rowCls+'" data-search="'+search+'">'+
      '<a href="'+url+'" class="match-inner" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Watch '+m.home_en+' vs '+m.away_en+' on HesGoal TV">'+inner+'</a></li>';
  }
  return '<li class="'+rowCls+'" data-search="'+search+'"><div class="match-inner">'+inner+'</div></li>';
}

function otherCard(m){
  var cat=m.category||{}, live=!!m.is_live;
  var url=STREAM+'stream.html?id='+m.id;
  var search=((cat.name||'')+' '+m.name).toLowerCase();
  var ic=sportIcon(cat.name,m.name);
  var pill;
  if(live){
    pill='<span class="m-pill m-pill-live">● LIVE</span>';
  } else {
    var upLabel='Upcoming';
    if(m.begin_at){
      var diff=Math.round((new Date(m.begin_at)-Date.now())/60000);
      if(diff>0){var h=Math.floor(diff/60),mn=diff%60;upLabel=h===0?'in '+mn+'m':mn===0?'in '+h+'h':'in '+h+'h '+mn+'m';}
    }
    pill='<span class="m-pill m-pill-upcoming">'+upLabel+'</span>';
  }
  var inner=
    '<span class="m-icon" aria-hidden="true">'+ic+'</span>'+
    '<span class="m-center">'+
      '<span class="m-league">'+(cat.name||'Sports')+'</span>'+
      '<span class="m-name">'+m.name+'</span>'+
    '</span>'+
    '<span class="m-right">'+pill+(live?'<i class="m-arrow" aria-hidden="true">›</i>':'')+'</span>';
  if(live){
    return '<li class="match-row" data-search="'+search+'">'+
      '<a href="'+url+'" class="match-inner" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Watch '+m.name+' on HesGoal TV">'+inner+'</a></li>';
  }
  return '<li class="match-row" data-search="'+search+'"><div class="match-inner" style="cursor:default">'+inner+'</div></li>';
}

function loadMatches(){
  show('loading-state'); hide('error-state');
  fetch(API+'api/matches/'+today()+'/1?t='+ts())
    .then(function(r){if(!r.ok)throw 0;return r.json();})
    .then(function(data){
      hide('loading-state');
      var matches=data.matches||[];
      if(!matches.length){
        show('loading-state');
        document.getElementById('loading-state').innerHTML=
          '<div style="font-size:36px;margin-bottom:10px">⚽</div>'+
          '<h3>No matches today</h3><p>Check back later for HesGoal live soccer streams.</p>';
        return;
      }
      var sorted=matches.slice().sort(function(a,b){
        function r(m){return m.status===1?0:m.status===2?2:1}
        return r(a)-r(b);
      });
      var ul=document.getElementById('match-grid');
      ul.innerHTML=sorted.map(soccerCard).join('');
      show('match-grid');
      var inp=document.getElementById('match-search');
      if(inp){inp.oninput=function(){var q=this.value.toLowerCase().trim();ul.querySelectorAll('li[data-search]').forEach(function(li){li.style.display=(!q||li.dataset.search.includes(q))?'':'none';});};}
    })
    .catch(function(){hide('loading-state');show('error-state');});
}
window.loadMatches=loadMatches;

function loadOther(){
  fetch(OTHER_API+'?t='+ts())
    .then(function(r){if(!r.ok)throw 0;return r.json();})
    .then(function(data){
      var items=(data.data||[]).filter(function(m){
        var c=((m.category&&m.category.sport_code)||'').toLowerCase();
        return c!=='soccer'&&c!=='football';
      });
      if(!items.length) return;
      items.sort(function(a,b){return(b.is_live?1:0)-(a.is_live?1:0);});
      document.getElementById('other-grid').innerHTML=items.map(otherCard).join('');
      show('other-bar');
      show('other-box');
    })
    .catch(function(){});
}

function loadAll(){loadMatches();loadOther();}
if(document.readyState==='loading'){
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',loadAll);
}else{
  loadAll();
}
})();
</script>

</body></html>
